_about: One style for the report figures, read by the R builders (R/style.R) and the PowerPoint schematics (pptx/style.js), so a chart and a diagram set side by side share palette, type and sizes. Sizes are in points at the printed size; widths in inches.
_colour_meaning: teal = economic interests; slate = institutions; deep teal = the model's own elements (ceiling S*, interactions, frames); dark grey = observed stringency S; coral = declared (not estimated). Sectors: power & industry blue, buildings & transport ochre.
